title: Flauz product overlay (product.flauz.json)
description: Schema for the Flauz product overlay consumed by build/flauz/merge-product.mjs. The overlay is merged onto the upstream Code OSS product.json with null-deletes semantics: an explicit JSON null DELETES the key from the merged product (e.g. "defaultChatAgent": null removes the Copilot setup/entitlement wiring), plain objects merge recursively, arrays and scalars replace wholesale. v0 is permissive (additionalProperties: true) — unknown keys pass through the merge but are warned about on stderr by the merger because the pinned upstream tree (9bf9ae764da) has no IProductConfiguration consumer for them. See build/flauz/README.md for the key-by-key rationale and canaries/default-agent-checklist.md for the runtime posture.

nameShort.description: Product short name (IProductConfiguration.nameShort, src/vs/base/common/product.ts:105). Rebrands the IDE identity (window titles, about dialog).

version.description: NOT a key of the shipped upstream product.json — upstream stamps version at build time from package.json (build/gulpfile.vscode.ts:176-205). Included in the overlay per the v0 work-order spec; flagged as DL-18 (version stamping conflict) — CI must reconcile this value with the build stamping.

extensionEnabledApiProposals.description: Force-enables API proposals for extensions by "publisher.name" key (case-insensitive). The product list REPLACES the extension's own package.json declaration (src/vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/extensionsProposedApi.ts:80-102). This is the DL-4 pattern: enable proposed APIs for trusted Flauz built-ins via product overlay, zero promotion/fork.

additionalProperties.description: List of API proposal names (unknown names are silently dropped with a log warning by extensionsProposedApi.ts:46-52).

defaultChatAgent.description: The upstream Copilot default-agent product block (product.json:90-157; IDefaultChatAgent at src/vs/base/common/product.ts). In the Flauz overlay this is ALWAYS null, which the merger translates into a key DELETION: the merged product has no defaultChatAgent, which no-ops the whole Copilot setup/entitlement stack (src/vs/workbench/services/chat/common/chatEntitlementService.ts:458-460) so that the statically-contributed flauz.agent participant becomes the sole default chat agent. See canaries/default-agent-checklist.md (D1-D11) for every surface this touches.
